title: Your Emergency Fund Is Secretly Costing You $106K
hook: Everybody says keep six months of expenses in cash — but nobody tells you that 'safe' pile of money has a six-figure price tag attached to it.
angle: Not generic 'save more' advice. Exposes the opportunity cost of over-hoarding cash in a low-yield account when smarter tiered alternatives keep you just as protected at far better returns.
audience: Adults 25-55 who have a traditional 6-month emergency fund sitting in a big bank savings account earning almost nothing
key_numbers: $150 — what that earns per year at 0.5%
$2,400 — what 8% market returns on $30K look like annually
1 in 4 — people who never touch their emergency fund
$1,400 — average cost of an actual emergency
